**Add an Anthropic `max_tokens` case to the provider harness. Do not add refusal or content-filter cases.** This PR changes the `stop_reason` that `POST /bedrock/model/{modelId}/invoke` returns for Anthropic models. `AGENTS.md` requires a provider-harness case for every wire-visible change under `core/`. The PR adds no case to `tests/e2e/api/collections/provider-harness.json`. The Anthropic `max_tokens` mapping has no end-to-end assertion. Add this case: - **Anthropic truncation:** Copy the request shape of `Bedrock InvokeModel: direct Anthropic shape`, use `{{bedrockModel}}` in the path, and set `max_tokens` to a small value. Assert that `stop_reason` is `"max_tokens"`. Fail on any unexpected status code, and include `pm.response.text()` in the failure message. Do not add `refusal` or `content_filter` cases. The harness documents refusal as non-deterministic and not produced in the live sweep. `TestToBedrockInvokeAnthropicResponse_StopReasonTranslation` already covers the `content_filter` to `refusal` mapping. The harness has no AI21 model or AI21 InvokeModel case. Adding one requires a new model variable and an AI21 model enabled for the harness account. Add that case when those conditions hold. Until then, the AI21 `length` mapping has Go coverage only.
